blocks.title: Quality assurance
blocks.text: Quality assurance yaqeeni banati hai ke project tay shuda maiyar poora kare aur theek kaam kare. Is mein testing, code ka jaaiza (review), stakeholders se raaye lena aur project ki taraqqi ki baqaida jaanch jaise tareeqe istemal hote hain.

blocks.title: Misal
blocks.text: Software project mein quality assurance ka matlab yaqeeni banana hai ke code durust likha gaya aur tawaqqo ke mutabiq kaam karta hai.

blocks.prompt: Quality assurance ke chaar tareeqe bataiye.
blocks.explanation: Testing, code reviews, stakeholders se raaye aur project ki taraqqi ki baqaida jaanch.

items: Quality assurance: yaqeeni banati hai ke project maiyar poora kare aur chale; tareeqe: testing, code review, stakeholders ki raaye, taraqqi ki jaanch.
